categories.description: New motion custom properties on :root: exit composites, duration and easing longhands, stagger and loop cycles, and the --nw-loop-state knob (FR-001, FR-002, FR-006). Existing --nw-tick/--nw-sweep/--nw-uplink are unchanged.

Reduced motion now wins over every intensity level (FR-006, known issue K1): under prefers-reduced-motion, --nw-motion-scale resolves to 0 and --nw-pulse-state and --nw-loop-state to paused, even with data-intensity set. Before, the intensity block won.

Consequence of motion-reduced (FR-006, K1): the existing --nw-tick, --nw-sweep and --nw-uplink composites multiply by --nw-motion-scale, so under reduced motion with data-intensity set they now compute to calc(<n>ms * 0) instead of * 0.6 (archive) or * 1.2 (combat).

Consequence of motion-reduced (FR-006, K1): the universal reduced-motion kill switch in accessibility.css does not reach pseudo-elements, so the switch knob (.switch .track::after) keeps a transition whose duration is --nw-tick. With data-intensity set that was 0.09s (archive) or 0.18s (combat) under reduced motion; it is now 0s.
